text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 280, December 13, 1970 ]
CREATING A PRESIDENTIAL CENSUS COORDINATING BOARD, AUTHORIZING THE
ESTABLISHMENT OF LOCAL CENSUS BOARDS, AND PROCLAIMING APRIL 1, 1971, AS CENSUS
DAY FOR AGRICULTURE AND FISHERIES
WHEREAS, Commonwealth Act No. 591 authorizes the Bureau of the Census and Statistics “to prepare for
and undertake all censuses of population, agriculture, industry and commerce”, and to conduct, for statistical
purposes, investigations and studies of social and economic problems and conditions in the country; and
Republic Act No. 6130 sets aside an appropriation for the taking of the 1971 Censuses of Agriculture and
WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of the above-mentioned Acts, the Bureau of the Census and Statistics
will undertake the 1971 Censuses of Agriculture and Fisheries; and
WHEREAS, to insure the success of this nationwide undertaking, it is deemed necessary to enlist the
cooperation and assistance of the various agencies of the national government as well as the local
governments;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create a Presidential Census Coordinating Board, which shall be responsible
for the systematic coordination of government agencies and instrumentalities involved in the conduct of the
1971 Censuses of Agriculture and Fisheries, to be composed of the following:
The Executive Secretary
The Secretary of Commerce and Industry
Vice-Chairman
The Secretary of National Defense
The Secretary of Education
The Secretary of Public Works and Communications
The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources
The Presidential Assistant on Community Development
The Director-General of the Presidential Economic Staff
The Board is hereby authorized to issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the
objectives of this Order.
As counterpart of the Presidential Census Coordinating Board, at the local government level, there shall be
established Provincial, City, Municipal/Municipal District and Barrio Census Board in each province, city,
municipality/municipal district and barrio to act as a consultative body and to provide such facilities and
assistance as shall be required by the Bureau of the Census and Statistics in the conduct of the 1971 Censuses
of Agriculture and Fisheries within their respective jurisdictions without extra compensation.
The Provincial Census Boards shall be composed of the Provincial Governors as chairman, and the highest
ranking provincial officials of the Philippine Fisheries Commission, the Bureau of the Agricultural
Economics, and the Agricultural Productivity Commission or, in their absence, the officials acting in their
stead, Division Superintendents of Schools, Provincial PACD Officers, Philippine Constabulary Commanders
and Provincial/District Engineers, as members.
The City Census Boards shall be composed of the City Mayors as chairman, and the highest ranking city
officials of the Philippine Fisheries Commission, the Bureau of Agricultural Economics, and the Agricultural
Productivity Commission or, in their absence, the officials acting in their stead, City Superintendents of
Schools, City PACD Officers and City Engineers, as members.
The Municipal/Municipal District Census Boards shall be composed of the Municipal/Municipal District
Mayors as chairman, and the highest ranking municipal/municipal district officials of the Philippine Fisheries
Commission, the Bureau of Agricultural Economics, and Agricultural Productivity Commission or, in their
absence, the officials acting in their stead, municipal PACD Officers, Public School Supervisors or Principal
Teachers, as members.
Each Provincial, City, and Municipal/Municipal District Census Board shall have a Secretariat to be headed
by an Executive Officer, which shall be composed of personnel from the different bureaus and agencies
represented in the Presidential Census Coordinating Board as well as from local governments. The Executive
Officer of the Presidential Census Coordinating Board shall be the Director of the Bureau of the Census and
Statistics.
The Barrio Census Boards shall be composed of the Barrio Captains as chairman, and the Barrio Councils and
Public School Head Teachers in the barrios, as members.
The supervisors, enumerators and other subordinate personnel for the census work shall be appointed by the
Director of the Census and Statistics and/or may be drafted from personnel of the Government, including
provincial, city and municipal officials and employees, school teachers, field forces of the different bureaus
and offices of the national government, city and municipal police forces, members of the Armed Forces of the
Philippines, and barrio captains.
All heads of departments, bureaus, offices and agencies of the government, including provincial, city and
municipal officials, and Philippine Constabulary Provincial Commanders, are hereby enjoined to make
available for purposes of census taking their facilities as well as the services of such personnel as may be
requested or requisitioned by the Bureau of the Census and Statistics.
April 1, 1971, is hereby designated as Census Day for Agriculture and Fisheries on which date collection of
all pertinent data shall commence and shall proceed on consecutive days from daylight to darkness including
Saturdays, Sundays and holidays until finally completed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
